registry.description: Rejoicing is the expressive, outward dimension of joy — the breaking out of inner gladness into movement, sound, and celebration. The Hebrew vocabulary here covers laughter, exultation, and the shout of joy. Rejoicing in Scripture is not a private matter; it tends to be communal and visible. The command to rejoice in the Lord is not an instruction to generate a feeling but to express what is genuinely true: that God is good, that his purposes stand, and that his people are in right relationship with him. Rejoicing is the form joy takes when it cannot be contained.
